Drive every browser task with the `dev-browser` CLI. Never use Cursor IDE Browser MCP (`cursor-ide-browser`, `browser_navigate`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_lock`, `browser_click`, `browser_cdp`, or any `browser_*` tool).

Install the CLI only when npm is allowed and the task needs persistence or CDP the bundled runtime cannot provide: `npm install -g dev-browser && dev-browser install`. When falling back to Playwright, keep the same proof (URL, title, errors, screenshots, exact steps) and state that the CLI was unavailable.

content.text:
I finished the mail app. The previous session had written nearly every component but stopped just before the entry point and shell, so the app couldn't load. `tsc` and `vite build` pass through Portly, and the dev server is up at `http://127.0.0.1:9235` (Portly temp job `tmp_56db2b41`), using pnpm only.

**What I added**
- **`src/main.tsx`**: the entry point.
- **`src/App.tsx`**: the app shell and the parts that tie the existing components together:
  - URL-based routing, with the drafts and scheduled folders using their own list view.
  - An optional split view with the message beside the list on wide screens (the reading-pane setting).
  - Mobile layout: slide-out menu and a floating Compose button.
  - Light/dark/system theme.
  - A 1-second background tick that sends queued mail when its undo window ends, sends scheduled mail, brings back snoozed mail, and delivers the simulated incoming replies, with toasts.
  - Gmail-style keyboard shortcuts: `c`, `/`, `j`/`k`, `o`/Enter, `u`, `x`, `s`, `e`, `#`, `!`, Shift+I, Shift+U, `+`/`-`, `z`, `r`/`a`/`f`, `g` then i/s/t/d/a, `*` then a/n/u/r/s, and `?`.
- **`src/components/Overlays.tsx`**:
  - The toast with Undo and a second action.
  - A Settings dialog: theme, density, reading pane, category tabs, undo-send delay, auto-advance, signature.
  - A keyboard-shortcuts sheet.
  - A dialog to create or edit a label; a new label is applied to any selected messages.
- **Titles**: the browser tab and the header now read "Claude Opus 5.5". The previous session had used "Opus 5.5".

**Fixes from testing**
- **Compose caret**: clicking the empty part of the message body put the cursor inside the signature, so typed text was glued to "--". It now lands in the first paragraph (checked in the page's HTML).
- **Split view**: the list side was cramped, with badges wrapping and subjects cut to one word. It now adjusts to its own width.
- **Small polish**: "Reply all" no longer wraps on mobile, and I changed a stray "Scanned by Opus 5.5" line to "Scanned for viruses".

**What I checked in a headless browser (no console errors)**
- **Desktop, 1440px**:
  - The inbox shows 18 conversations with category tabs, and every folder fills with data.
  - Opening a message marks it read.
  - `s` stars it, `e` archives it and returns to the list with an Undo toast, and `z` undoes it.
  - `j`/`j`/`x` moves down the list and selects a row.
  - Searching `from:priya has:attachment` shows suggestions and 2 results.
- **Composing**:
  - Contact suggestions work, and the draft autosaves.
  - Cmd+Enter queues the message with an Undo toast; about 5 seconds later it is delivered and shows at the top of Sent.
  - An inline reply added a message to the conversation and queued a simulated answer.
  - The scheduled incoming message ("Replica sizing for Atlas") arrived.
- **Labels and settings**: creating a label works. Saving dark theme plus the split view both take effect.
- **Mobile, 390×844**: no horizontal scrolling; the menu, Starred, opening a message, back, and full-screen compose all work.

One thing I didn't clean up: the dev server is still running on 9235 and will time out after 90 minutes. Stop it with `portly stop` when you're done.
